pages.text: The Xianeng Mana Crystal and Xianeng Source Crystal are optional integration variants and leave no empty registry entries when their target mods are absent. The Electricity Crystal is unconditional; the Mana Crystal registers only with Botania, and the Source Crystal only with Ars Nouveau. All three share structure, non-color rendering, UI, fuel, the 800,000,000 default capacity, 1,000 resource per tick, and the two output switches.

The Xianeng Mana Crystal exists only with Botania and uses the green crystal palette. Its cache is Botania Mana: active six-face output searches official ManaReceiver targets, including Mana Pools. The processing slot accepts ManaItem containers such as Mana Tablets and Mana Rings; once full, the complete item moves to the extra slot. The extra slot still rejects manual input, never writes to Xianqiao, and only extracts from below.

The Mana Crystal accepts a Botania Spark through the official SparkAttachable capability. The attachment state is stored in block data and reconciled after a world reload, so a reload does not incorrectly drop or duplicate the Spark. With Xianqiao Output enabled, its Mana cache reads the owner's Mana ledger; closing it detaches the ledger and resumes a local cache from zero. Automatic Output only controls six-face Mana pushes and never replaces the Xianqiao switch.

The Xianeng Source Crystal exists only with Ars Nouveau and uses the purple crystal palette. Its cache is Ars Nouveau Source: active six-face output searches containers registered through ISourceCap, such as Source Jars. The processing slot accepts Source containers, charges them to full, and moves the complete container into the extra slot. The extra slot likewise never writes to Xianqiao and can only be extracted from below.

The Dominion Wand uses Ars Nouveau's IWandable protocol on a Source Crystal: the first connection records the Source start and the last connection records the priority point; clearing connections clears both marks. These flags are stored in block data and survive a game reload. They mark Source-network endpoints only; they do not change burn production or the extra-slot output restriction.

With Xianqiao Output enabled, the Source Crystal's Source capability, Xianqiao meter, and external storage access all point to the owner's long-valued Source ledger; closing it detaches the ledger and resumes a local cache from zero. Automatic Output remains independent and attempts to push the complete available cache every tick to enabled six-face ISourceCap containers.

The three variants form one Xianeng Crystal family. A stonecutter can convert between any variants that currently exist; the crafting table has one shapeless conversion from the current existing variant to the next existing variant in order. If Botania or Ars Nouveau is absent, its block, item, capability, and recipes are not loaded, allowing a modpack to keep only Electricity or any available combination of variants.

Mana and Source are independent resource ledgers, not FE, and do not invoke the old non-Source Immortal Yuan external-resource conversion. Immortal Yuan and True Yuan are fuel in a crystal, not a resource-conversion exchange. Source Veins retain their own established Immortal Yuan charging and conversion behavior. AE2, RS, and the corresponding official capabilities connect only when their target integration exists and use the same long-valued ledger.
